label: Create table boardOwner
summary: Creates table boardOwner with required columns

precheck.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = 0 AS "result" FROM "sqlite_master" WHERE ("type" = ? AND "name" = ?)

execute.sql:
CREATE TABLE "boardOwner" (
  "boardId" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "ownerId" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "ownerKind" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("boardId"),
  UNIQUE ("ownerKind", "ownerId")
)

postcheck.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 AS "result" FROM "sqlite_master" WHERE ("type" = ? AND "name" = ?)
